summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 4 new Quick Wing features: 1) Request a Lift sticky button for staff on mobile, 2) Live Fleet Status dashboard with 30s auto-refresh, 3) Individual Car Calendars with 07:00-22:00 time slots and color coding, 4) All Cars monthly calendar with drill-down. All 15 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified working correctly.
